reviews.review:
This game does just about everything right.... well mostly, but maybe its just my taste. The gameplay is superb (will give further insight later on), the soundtrack is no less audiophoria at worst, eargasm at best, almost threw out my damn neck 1000/10. I love the comic book aesthetic the visuals is vibrant and colorful pretty much borderlandsy, and those "ratatata" text that shows up when you're tearing asses apart really sealed the deal for me, with regards to support Its pretty welcoming to find developers who are this passionate about their game it genuinely reflects with every update.
Now that being said, I began damn near worshiping this game but just one small trope and I mean that with every sense of the word..... Its not an issue or even a con like that more so a trope, the characters are pretty F***ing underwhelming tbh, Only one character is worth a damn in my opinion and that's the commando the others to me are either boring or mediocre which greatly diminishes the replayability character wise (the replay loop regarding gameplay is one of the best i've ever played though). Everything else is done so well, the game itself is addicting as hell. 'Just one more run" and before you know it, good God its 4:am in the morning. Who knows? maybe you'll like those other playable characters but I sure as s**t know you'll enjoy this game and (for the most part) everything it has to offer.......Its in early access so all my observations may be rectified overtime but if not its still one fantastic hell of a game here. Good Job RyseUp.

This game is very fun to play. I have watched it grow a lot in early access and the direction the dev team is moving in has been really cool to see. The game keeps getting refined and is an enjoyable experience from start to finish. I hardly play games anymore, but this one is my current favorite.

Looks like a very promising early access game. 

What I like :)
It has amazing gunplay, whomever made these satisfying weapons needs a raise. 
Movement is very fun, and you can really start to fly around the map when you get the hang of it.

What I would like to see.
Fully fleshed out campaign with some world building would be nice but not necessary.
More enemy variety. 
Incentives to go to one location or the other.
Feels a little barren in game maybe some more NPCs to like talk to, that could upgrade your weapon or reroll a stat.

Overall I definitely recommend this game and i will be revisiting it when more content arrives :D
